description:
Ask for missing information that materially changes the target, scope, or result. Resolve answers available from context or focused investigation first; ordinary implementation choices can follow project conventions.

Provide a specific question and at most 3 concise options. The last option must allow custom input; the preceding options cover the most likely choices. Use labels of 1-5 words. Reuse prior answers and authorization.

question.description: The complete question to ask the user. Be specific about what you need to know and why.

options.description: At most 3 options; the final option allows custom text input.

label.description: Short display text for this option (1-5 words)

description.description: Brief explanation of what this option means or will do
